acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Guest host Elna Baker hears of a story from Jane Marie, about an embarrassing moment that haunts her.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Elna Baker picks up with Jane Marie’s story. Jane Marie is the host of the podcast The Dream.
acts.title: The Belle of the Gall

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc:
Writer Kiese Laymon tells Elna Baker his most embarrassing story, involving one of the most important people in his life.
Kiese Laymon is the author of Heavy and Long Division.
acts.title: Judgment Day

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: We put out a call for embarrassing stories and got back more than 1000. Guest host Elna Baker tells Ira Glass about some of her favorites.
acts.title: Traumarama

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: Cariad Harmon tells Elna Baker about what it was like to live through a literal embarrassment nightmare.
acts.title: Putting the Bare Ass in Embarrassment
